fusions.name: Ruled Lines
fusions.desc: Draws a ring of ink bars around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 0.8 seconds. Every enemy hit is then [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Closed Case
fusions.desc: Sends a closed file into the first enemy it meets, dealing 16 damage. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Barred Passage
fusions.desc: Draws a wall of ink bars 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing can cross it.

fusions.name: Docket Entry
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you regain 5 mana. Once every 6 seconds.
